title: Man with Glowing Orbs
description: A man in a black coat stands centered within a large circular geometric frame, holding two glowing orbs in his hands. The left orb contains a red ladybug and a purple cat-like creature, while the right orb shows a walking figure and geometric symbols, all set against a split black and white background filled with abstract line art.
prompt: A surreal black and white illustration of a stern man in a long black coat standing inside a large circular geometric frame with glowing blue and orange rings, he holds two glowing orbs one in each hand, the left orb contains a red ladybug and purple cat creature with dripping paint effects, the right orb shows a walking silhouette and geometric symbols, intricate line art of crystals stairs and abstract shapes fill the split black and white background, detailed linework with selective color accents
